task: Report proposed inscription coverage, cognitive obstacles and next steps
approach: Reused the prior source inventory, registry and retrospectives. Searched the local manuscript and twelve lecture captions, then read the relevant passages. Opened the author's manuscript and six-page letter on the web to verify attribution.
challenge: The sources mix sign coverage, full readings of individual fields, partial readings of inscriptions and general functional interpretation. The retained 410-label source index cannot be substituted for a deciphered-object census. A search within the ignored raw directory needed the explicit no-ignore option.
fix: Kept author sign counts and unreported inscription totals separate. Located the field-completeness qualification in Section IV, the unresolved-work passages in Lecture 10 and the manuscript conclusion, and the deeper AI cross-check proposal in the letter.
outcome: Recorded 55–56 proposed phonetic/logographic signs and around 70 including general functions. Exact totals of fully read, partly read and unread inscriptions were not found. Summarized five cognitive/data constraints and seven proposed work directions with source locators.
verification: New JSON is checked for parseability and local source links; no statistical or archaeological claim was tested.
